# skill-scorecard

> Zero-dependency CLI to score any AI skill across four angles: Registered / Trustworthy / Safe / Machine-readable. LGD Doctrine (Register·Verify·Gate) as an executable standard.

- Usage: `python skill_scorecard.py <path> --json` (exit 0=PASS 1=FAIL), `--verified` mints a verifiable LGD VERIFIED badge
- Repo: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/skill-scorecard
- Standard: LGD Four-Angle AI Skill Scoring (Registered 有籍 / Trustworthy 有证 / Safe 有门禁 / Machine 机器可读); Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23387670
- Truthfulness: static heuristic, not certification; reproducible via sha256
- lgd-skill-marketplace: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-marketplace (full skill catalog — enter here for all skills)
